# Cully 0.17.0

- **Audit the setup around your agent.** `cully harness` reports instructions, guardrails, memory, skills, subagents, hooks and plugins without changing configuration. It detects supported global/project sources and shared skill directories. Plugins are optional; a found configuration is not proof of a working connection.
- **The panel now leads with Harness.** See setup readiness, named gaps, historical output estimates, model and pending verification, alongside Project & usage and Cully impact. Compact layouts preserve MCP health/authentication, hide unavailable quota/Git values and identify historical Claude measurements.
- **Safer, consistent measurements.** Harness sampling streams recent local Claude transcripts from the exact project folder, excludes nested histories and counts actual subagent calls. Relative paths resolve correctly, nonpositive limits return errors and stale background measurements cannot overwrite the active project. The CLI and panel share delegation evidence.
- **Token advice needs evidence.** The advisor prompt requires measured signal figures in token-spend recommendations and token-waste tool gaps; otherwise it should stay quiet. Generated advice still needs review.
- **Guides and website refreshed.** New harness, token-impact and mobile-preview guides cover current commands, defaults, privacy and verification limits. The homepage now explains impact/savings reports, advisor replay, optional workflow context and verified CLI updates. Mobile remains a source-built developer preview, with no store distribution or Team actions.

Install the CLI with `cully update --version v0.17.0`, or rerun the [installer](https://docs.cully.net/installation). Open a new Cully terminal for the updated renderer. Refresh managed hooks/skills with `cully setup` using your original options; upgrade memory services separately through your deployment tooling.

Harness output estimates use recent local Claude transcripts, including while another agent runs in the terminal. They are size-based historical estimates, not billed usage or causal proof of savings. See [harness](https://docs.cully.net/harness), [token impact](https://docs.cully.net/token-impact) and [privacy](https://docs.cully.net/privacy).
